title: First shipment missing pieces couldn’t be put together! 2nd order was complete.
text:
First shipment missing pieces couldn’t be put together! 2nd order was complete.. I’m unable to put the three tiered rack together. It came well packed and the acrylic shelves were sealed in brown paper.
Unfortunately there were a number of pieces (see accompanying picture) that were missing and the rack couldn’t be put together without them!
I’m going to try ordering another one and hopefully that one will be usable!
Received a refund on the first order and the second rack came with all the pieces. Easy enough to put together and seems sturdy. Didn’t appreciate being inconvenienced because the first order was supposed to be completely assembled and given as a gift.
